privileged_info_for_vlm: The dim_date table must contain exactly 1,826 rows to cover the range 2009-01-01 to 2013-12-31 (including the 2012 leap year). The earliest invoice in the database is 2009-01-01 and the latest is 2013-12-22. The view v_monthly_density must group by MonthKey (format YYYY-MM). ZeroSalesDays is the count of dates in dim_date for which no corresponding invoice exists in the invoices table for that month.
